info.name: SmartPark - API Test Suite
info.description: Import this collection and SmartPark.local.postman_environment.json, then select SmartPark - Local. All durable variables live in that environment. Four folders preserve all 91 requests: Auth smoke, Manual workflows, Payment pricing and Authorization audit. Run only a prepared folder; do not run the whole suite unattended because onboarding needs OTP/invitation/TOTP and optional branches. No live API, database or provider readiness is implied by import. Current instructions: docs/04-testing/postman/README.md.

exec: throw new Error('Select the imported SmartPark - Local environment before sending requests.');

item.name: 00 Auth smoke - Runner
item.description: Run this folder alone with Collection Runner (11 requests in order). Set smokeEmail/smokePassword in SmartPark - Local. Requires a verified active Driver with MFA off.
